public/vendor/googlecloud-logo.png — the Google Cloud mark used on the film thumbnail (`--mark gcp`)
==================================================================================================

WHAT IT IS
  Google's four-colour cloud (the "super cloud" gradient mark), 192x192 PNG with transparency.
  Used by scripts/thumb-film.mjs for `--mark gcp`, embedded AS SUPPLIED: never recoloured,
  re-traced, cropped, re-proportioned or otherwise altered. The cover draws it at 104x104.

WHERE IT CAME FROM
  Downloaded byte for byte on 2026-11-04 from https://www.gstatic.com/cgc/super_cloud_gradient.png,
  the file https://cloud.google.com/ names as its own apple-touch-icon.
  SHA-256 a332b54b620a2fa04413561c01c925cd40f936581c7bed52df424ecccc9c08b4.

  Google publishes no SVG of this mark at that address (its site lockup,
  https://www.gstatic.com/cgc/google-cloud-logo-fullcolor.svg, is the "Google Cloud" wordmark
  without the cloud). If a vector original turns up from Google's own brand resources, vendor it
  here unaltered and point `MARKS.gcp` at it.

THE TERMS THAT APPLY
  The mark is Google's trademark. Google's brand guidelines govern its use; read their current
  text before publishing: they are the authority, and this note is not. The cover must not
  suggest that Google produced, sponsored or endorsed the course. GraphL's FULL COURSE badge and
  the "data engineering" line are the course's own identity, and nothing on it says otherwise.
